logline: A small creature's shadow runs off at sunset; force cannot catch it, so the creature dances until the copycat shadow cannot resist copying its way back.
ending: The sun sets, the meadow goes dark and the shadow vanishes with the light; Pim looks down, worried, and two white eyes open on the dark grass beside its feet and wink.
opening_promise: Pim walks onto a sunset meadow and stops to enjoy the view; its long shadow copies every move, one beat late.

continuity.what: Pim and its shadow on one sunset meadow; the sun's height drives shadow length and, at the end, the dark.

style_sheet.look: Flat bold cartoon: solid shapes, 7-unit dark plum outlines, no gradients on characters, a backlit sunset sky graded from violet to gold.
style_sheet.materials: flat paint; grass tufts and cloud wisps as simple strokes; shadows as one flat plum layer at uniform opacity so overlapping parts never double-darken

characters.design: Egg-shaped cream body, long red stocking cap that flops with a white pompom, big oval eyes, pink cheeks, stubby legs with plum boots, noodle arms with mitten hands.
characters.silhouette: round body under a tall curved cap: readable as a dot with a hook at 360 px

characters.design: Pim's exact silhouette in flat plum; flat on the ground it is a projection of Pim's pose, standing it becomes a dark twin with white eyes and a pink tongue.

style_sheet.environment: One hilltop meadow at sunset: low sun half behind far hills, a lone tree on the left whose long shadow lies down the lower-left of frame, grass tufts. Light only from the sun, behind the characters, so every shadow falls toward the viewer.
style_sheet.framing: One continuous take in 9:16; the camera pushes in for the lag and the double take, pulls wide for the chase, and settles close for the stomp and the final wink.
style_sheet.sound_intent: Silent comedy: a plucky pizzicato and marimba score that stops dead for the double take, mickey-mousing footsteps, squeaks, a raspberry, a faceplant thud and a stomp; the score falls away to a few celesta notes in the dark.

audio.music: original note-list score (pizzicato, marimba, celesta) synthesised in code
audio.sfx: seeded procedural sound design placed on the picture's moment table

shots.purpose: establish Pim, the meadow and a shadow that copies
shots.sees: Pim walks in and stops to sigh at the sunset; the long shadow on the grass walks and sighs with it

shots.purpose: reveal the shadow has a mind of its own
shots.sees: Pim stretches; the shadow holds the stretch after Pim stops, adds an extra flourish, then snaps innocent when Pim double-takes
Pim leans in to squint; the shadow slides away from Pim's feet, hinges up into a dark twin with white eyes, blows a raspberry and sprints off, leaving Pim with no shadow at all
shots.before: shadow on the ground at Pim's feet

shots.sees: Pim chases; the twin dives flat into the tree's long shade and disappears; Pim's hat-net dive lands face-first and two white eyes giggle from the shade
shots.after: twin hidden in shade, Pim face-down
shots.cause: the shadow melting into darker shadow

shots.sees: Pim gets an idea and dances in the sunlight; the shadow cannot resist copying, slides out of the shade copying the dance and creeps to Pim's feet; Pim stomps on its feet and it snaps back attached
shots.after: shadow pinned back in place, Pim smug
shots.cause: the shadow's urge to copy, planted in the opening

shots.purpose: button: the shadow gets the last word
shots.sees: the sun sinks, the light and every shadow fade, Pim looks down worried, and two white eyes open in the dark grass by its feet and wink
shots.stillness: a held dark beat before the eyes open

hardest_shot.why: The shadow must read as Pim's own projection, then visibly detach, hinge up into a standing twin and run, while Pim's feet are left without a shadow; if the detach or the stand-up reads as a sticker swap the premise fails.
hardest_shot.fallback: Stage the escape as the flat shadow sliding away along the grass without standing up, and keep the dark twin for the chase only.

applicability.picture_sound_link: Silent comedy by design: no narration or dialogue; sound is score and effects only.
